Title: Force of Will Question and possible use for Movement of the Slow Body

Messages.Author: Biomech8
Messages.Body:
When Force of Will untaps the acting minion do they retap to do the bleed
or remain untapped? If they have to tap read further, if not please
ignore the following.

Now that I have read Force of Will I assume that it keeps the acting
minion untapped and so the following examples were played wrong. If not
they worked very well:
New use: This card works beautifully with Force of Will and Rapid Healing
(If my interpretation of Force of Will was correct). While teaching some
kids how to play yesterday I had Joaquina Amaya out with two protean skill
cards on her and I played Giant's blood on her. My prey had two untapped
minions, Joaquina attempted to bleed, was blocked and played greater Earth
Meld, then she attempted again, was blocked and played greater Earth Meld.
Then she bleed successfully for 1, Freak Drived and bled again, played
Force of Will and bled at +2 and went to torpor, used Movement of the Slow
Body and Rapid Healing to get herself out of torpor (and gain blood) and
then used Force of Will again for another +2 bleed and then finding
herself in torpor again she used Movement of the slow body to untap and
then pulled herself out of torpor with two blood. She bled for 8 points
with only fortitude an protean. Just think if it had been Stanislava! I
did something similar with Natalia (and one protean skill card) the other
night only she only freaked and then forced her will and then used
movement of the slow body and rapid healing.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Yes, a vampire uses Force of Will taps again, as it takes the bleed action.
Yes, it is possible to get into a loop with Force of Will, Movement of
the Slow Body, and Rapid Healing.
